research_rationale:
EO 11093 (1963-02-26; Assigning emergency preparedness functions to the Administrator of General Services): the held Federal Register text was checked against its heading, numbered sections and closing date, and searched for expiry, "until", termination and effective-date wording. The order assigns continuing emergency preparedness planning functions and its own terms contain no end date or end condition. The end is EO 11490 of October 28, 1969, whose Sec. 3015 revokes the order by number; the end source is the Federal Register text of EO 11490 (34 FR 17567 onward, issue of October 30, 1969), held as the family-rule-tail text file. The held texts citing this order's number were searched with the repository number lookup and no earlier revocation or supersession was found. The order also revoked earlier issuances by its own closing sentence where one is stated, a one-time act recorded as a separate scope. The legal cutoff is 2026-10-14; no continuing predicate is needed for a NO order.

savings.reason: No provision of EO 11490 sections 3011 to 3015, the span quoted as the end source, preserves EO 11093 after its revocation; section 3014 retains existing assignments only "Except as provided in Section 3015". The completed revocation of any earlier emergency preparedness or mobilization order stays effective as a spent act. I did not search the remainder of EO 11490 for successor assignments to the same agency, so no transfer of this order's commands is claimed.
